## Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)  # AI-EDIT(2026-06-23): tidyverse-default — consolidated core library() calls into library(tidyverse)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
nhanes <- read_csv("examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Inspect

```{r}
dim(nhanes)
names(nhanes)
glimpse(nhanes)
colSums(is.na(nhanes))
```

## Summarize

Replace this example with your own summary if you choose a different question.

```{r}
Age_summary <- nhanes |>
  filter(!is.na(Cycle), !is.na(Age)) |>
  group_by(Cycle) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_Age = mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Age_summary
```

## Function

```{r}
mean_with_n <- function(x) {
  tibble(
    n = sum(!is.na(x)),
    mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

mean_with_n(nhanes$Age)
```

## Save Output

```{r}
dir.create("assignments/assignment02-r-with-ai/submission/output", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(Age_summary, "assignments/assignment02-r-with-ai/submission/output/summary_table.csv")
```

## AI Audit Note

Ai was only used for defining functions like filter(), group_by(), summarise(), and mean_with_n(). The rest of the code was used from the template.
